fields.description: Issue includes an editorial attacking John S. Knight and criticizing Miami Beach police practices toward unemployed and destitute visitors, alongside commentary on Senator Claude Pepper and press politics. Local reporting covers Miami police methods and court cases involving vice enforcement and alleged entrapment (including a detailed report on the Lenox Hotel raid), bookmaking arrests, and automobile break-ins. Additional items address downtown business conditions and rents, civic matters such as opposition to locating a fire station on a school playground near Allapattah School, and assorted columns, letters, and advertisements related to Miami-area nightlife and entertainment.
